faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get quick answers about the kebaikanku.id platform
faq.a1: Yes, if you self-host the open-source version, kebaikanku.id charges zero platform fees. However, you will still pay Midtrans transaction fees directly at their standard rates (usually Rp 2,000 - Rp 4,000 for Virtual Accounts, or 0.7% for QRIS).
faq.q2: What is the difference between Self-Hosted and Managed Cloud?
faq.a2: The Self-Hosted version requires an IT team to manage code, set up servers, install databases, and handle maintenance. The Managed Cloud version is fully hosted by us: you register, upload verification documents, and start receiving donations in 5 minutes without server worries.
faq.q3: Why do you use the AGPL-3.0 license?
faq.a3: The AGPL-3.0 license ensures the project remains open and beneficial. Anyone is free to modify it, but if they host it as a web service (SaaS), they must open-source their changes so the community can learn and build together.
faq.q4: How does the AI Report Generator work?
faq.a4: It simplifies reporting. Field staff upload receipt photos or documentation and a short note (or voice note). The AI (CrewAI) compiles a clean report, publishes it, and automatically updates donors via WhatsApp.
